newsitem.title: UK: Two of three Brent dates kept - trade.
newsitem.headline: Two of three Brent dates kept - trade.

text.p: Two of the three Brent cargoes turning wet on Wednesday were kept well ahead of the five o' clock deadline, traders said.

The cargoes, due to load in the June 12-14 period were kept by Glencore and Rheinoil. The third cargo, originally due to load June 9-11 and defered to June 12-14 was being notionally offered for sale by the equity holder at July Brent -10 cents.

Trading sources close to the Brent crude oil system said that some of the deferrals seen in the June loading programme were a result of a delay in Brent Alpha reaching full production following maintenance. On Wednesday the field was running as normal, they added.
